title: Assistant Manager
jobDescription:
Designation : Assistant Manager

Level : L3

Location : Bengaluru, Karnataka , India (BLR)

Experience : 5 to 8 Years


Job Role :

We're looking for someone who sits at the intersection of engineering and communication — someone who

understands how systems are built and can turn that understanding into whitepapers, patent filings, technical

articles, and IP documentation that land with both engineering and business audiences.

You'll be embedded in a team building AI-powered marketing automation platforms, giving you first-hand

exposure to production full-stack systems, Gen AI workflows, and LLM integrations. Your job is to capture

and articulate the thinking behind that work.

This is an equal-split role — half your time is engineering contribution (reading code, participating in design

discussions, prototyping ideas, run and maintenance of existing tools), and half is producing high-quality

written output that represents the team's technical thinking internally and externally.


What You'll Do

Technical Writing & Thought Leadership

● Author whitepapers, technical POVs, and business-facing articles on full-stack engineering and

AI/LLM topics — architectural decisions, emerging trends, and best practices

● Write engineering blog posts and external-facing content that makes complex systems accessible

without sacrificing technical accuracy

● Translate system design discussions, architecture reviews, and code into clear, structured

documentation

● Maintain and evolve internal knowledge bases, runbooks, and API documentation IP Documentation & Patent Filing

● Identify and document patentable ideas and novel technical approaches arising from team engagements

● Work with engineers to structure invention disclosures clearly and completely

● Partner with legal and IP teams through the patent filing process

● Maintain an IP pipeline — tracking ideas from initial identification through filing Research & Paper Writing

● Support paper writing and research documentation for novel approaches in Gen AI, agentic workflows, and full-stack architecture

● Monitor relevant research and industry publications to inform internal POVs and keep the team's thinking current Engineering Participation

● Read and understand production code, system designs, and architecture diagrams

● Participate in design reviews and technical discussions to extract documentable insights

● Build lightweight prototypes or POCs where needed to support written content


What You Need to Succeed

Required

● 3–6 years of experience in a technical writing, developer relations, or engineering role with a

significant writing component

● Solid engineering foundation — you can read code, follow a system design conversation, and

understand distributed systems concepts without needing them translated

● Demonstrated ability to write clearly for both technical (engineers, architects) and non-technical

(business, leadership) audiences — a portfolio or writing samples are required

● Familiarity with full-stack concepts: APIs, frontend/backend architecture, distributed systems,

microservices

● Familiarity with AI/LLM topics: RAG, agents, prompt engineering, model evaluation, vector

databases

● Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline

preferred — equivalent practical experience in a technical domain will be considered

Nice to Have

● Prior experience contributing to or filing patent applications

● Published technical articles, blog posts, or conference papers — share links if available

● Exposure to Ad Tech, marketing automation, or data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks)

● Familiarity with documentation tools (Confluence, Notion, Git Book) and docs-as-code workflows

● Experience working in or alongside an engineering team (not just writing about engineering from the

outside)



Required skills :

Content Writing (whitepapers, patent filings, technical articles, IP documentation, Blogs)

Full-stack systems, Gen AI workflows, and LLM integrations.

title: Assistant Manager - Data Engineering
jobDescription:
Designation: Assistant Manager - Data Engineering

Experience: 7 to 10 Years

Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu , India (CHN)


Job Description:

We are seeking a GCP Data Engineer to design and build scalable semantic data layers from unstructured and multi-modal content such as PDFs, Power Point presentations, and embedded images. The role focuses on developing robust data ingestion pipelines, semantic modeling, vector-based search capabilities, and enterprise data solutions on Google Cloud Platform. Exposure to Agentic AI frameworks and orchestration is desirable but secondary.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and develop data pipelines to ingest, process, and transform unstructured data from PDFs, PPTs, and images.

  • Utilize GCP services such as Document AI, Cloud Storage, Big Query, and Vertex AI for document and image data extraction.

  • Generate and manage embeddings for semantic search and retrieval using Vertex AI and Big Query Vector Search.

  • Build and maintain semantic data models that combine structured business data with unstructured content insights.

  • Develop and optimize Big Query-based data warehouses and semantic layers for analytics and reporting.

  • Orchestrate end-to-end workflows using Cloud Composer (Airflow) or GCP Workflows.

  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to define semantic data structures and metadata standards.

  • Support integration of semantic data platforms with Agentic AI and enterprise AI applications.

Required Skills:

  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Big Query, Cloud Storage, Document AI, Vertex AI.

  • Strong SQL and data modeling expertise.

  • Experience with unstructured document processing and multi-modal data pipelines.

  • Vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search implementation.

  • Workflow orchestration using Airflow/Cloud Composer.

  • Knowledge of Looker, dbt, or semantic layer frameworks.

  • Familiarity with Agentic AI, Lang Chain, Genkit, or Vertex AI Agent Builder (preferred).

title: Assistant Manager
jobDescription:
Designation : Assistant Manager

Level : L3

Location : Chennai

Experince : 5 to 8 Years


Job Role :

proactive and detail-oriented Analytics Engineer to bridge the gap between raw data engineering and business analytics. In this role, your primary focus will be designing, building, and maintaining robust, scalable data pipelines and transformed datasets that empower our analytics and business teams to derive clear insights.

You will own the transformation layer of our data stack—turning raw, multi-source data into clean, well-modeled, and well-documented data products.


Responsibilities :

Data Pipeline & Transformation: Build, optimize, and maintain automated ELT/ETL data pipelines to ingest and transform data from diverse operational systems into our data warehouse.

Data Modeling: Design clean, scalable, and intuitive dimensional data models (e.g., Kimball methodology, star schemas) tailored for analytics and reporting performance.

Analytics Support: Collaborate closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and Business Stakeholders to understand their data requirements and translate them into reliable data pipelines.

Data Quality & Testing: Implement automated testing, monitoring, and data validation rules to ensure high data integrity, reliability, and freshness.

Documentation & Governance: Maintain clear documentation of data lineage, data dictionaries, and transformation logic to maintain high data governance standards.

Performance Optimization: Audit and optimize slow-running SQL queries, data transformations, and data pipeline execution time



Required skills :

Advanced SQL: Expertise in writing complex, highly performant SQL queries, window functions, CTEs, and query optimization. Data Transformation & Modeling: Strong hands-on experience using modern transformation tools like dbt (data build tool) and a solid foundation in data warehousing methodologies (star schema, snowflake schema). Cloud Data Warehouses: Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, Google Big Query, Amazon Redshift, or Databricks. Data Pipeline Orchestration: Proven experience building and orchestrating pipelines using tools like Apache Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or Fivetran. Version Control & CI/CD: Proficiency with Git and modern software engineering practices applied to data (code reviews, testing, deployment pipelines).

Python / Scripting: Familiarity with Python for custom data scripting, API integrations, and automation (e.g., pandas, requests). BI & Visualization Integration: Experience interfacing with Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI) to optimize datasets for reporting performance. Data Governance & Quality: Hands-on experience with data quality and testing tools like Great Expectations or Soda.

title: Assistant Manager - Data Science
jobDescription:
Designation:Assistant Manager – Data Science

Level: L3

Experience: 6 to 10 years

Location: Bengaluru

Job Description:

We are looking for a Gen AI Engineer to bridge the gap between complex marketing data and actionable strategy. You will design and deploy an AI Data Agent capable of navigating our marketing databases to perform autonomous analysis, provide natural language insights, and suggest optimizations for campaigns and activities. This role is unique: you will build the "brain" (the LLM agent) and the "eyes" (the visualization dashboards) simultaneously to create a unified performance ecosystem.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Agent Architecture: Design and implement an LLM-based agent using frameworks like Lang Chain, Crew AI, or Auto GPT that can interface with SQL/No SQL marketing databases.

  • RAG & Tool Use: Develop Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and "tools" that allow the agent to query live performance data, compare historical benchmarks, and perform statistical significance testing.

  • Insight Synthesis: Fine-tune models or engineer complex prompts to transform raw data (CTR, ROAS, Customer Acquisition Cost) into high-level executive summaries and strategic recommendations.

  • Dashboard Integration: Build or integrate with interactive dashboards (e.g., Streamlit, Tableau, or Power BI) where the agent can "explain" the visualizations to stakeholders.

  • Data Orchestration: Work with data engineers to ensure the marketing data layer is optimized for LLM "readability" (clean schemas and metadata).
  • Evaluation & Guardrails: Implement evaluation frameworks to ensure the agent’s insights are factually accurate, non-hallucinatory, and grounded in the actual marketing data.

Skills:

  • Experience with GPT-4, Claude 3.5, or open-source models (Llama 3, Mistral) and prompt engineering.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Python (Pandas/Num Py), Streamlit, Plotly, D3.js, or integration experience with BI tools.

title: Assistant Manager - Data Science
jobDescription:
Designation: Assistant Manager – Data Science

Level: L3

Experience: 6 to 10 years

Location: Colombo

Job Description:

We are looking for experienced Data Scientist to join our team.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Decision Science – Credit Risk Modelling and Portfolio Optimization

  • Build statistically robust application and behavior scorecards; develop PD, LGD, and EAD models

  • Design loss‑forecasting frameworks (vintage, roll‑rate/Markov, survival/hazard, GLM/GBM) at segment and portfolio levels.

  • Engineer features from bureau, internal behavioral, transaction, device, and alternative data with rigorous data QC.

  • Calibrate and backtest models; perform stability monitoring (PSI/CSI), discrimination (KS/AUC), and calibration tests.

  • Implement explainability (reason codes/SHAP), bias/fair‑lending checks, and challenger/benchmark models.

  • Align models to accounting and capital frameworks (IFRS 9 or CECL; Basel PD/LGD/EAD concepts).

  • Development of credit card portfolio optimization data models to drive spends and engagement

  • Portfolio Spends Growth – Targeting basis segments/persona, merchants, campaign recommendation to drive cross border

Skills:

  • Must have working knowledge of credit cards

  • Must have hands on knowledge of building application score, behavior score, PD, LGD models

  • Solid understanding of IFRS 9 or CECL (lifetime ECL, staging/pooling), and model risk governance

  • Solid understanding of credit card lifecycle and credit card portfolio interventions

  • Python, ML, SQL, SAS and Tableau

  • Communication skills to explain complex methods to non‑technical audiences; clear documentation.

  • Exposure to bureau data (e.g., attributes, reason codes), alternative data, and identity/behavioral signals.

  • Exposure to transaction level credit card spends data

  • Credit risk modelling (IFRS 9, Python, ML, SQL, SAS and Tableau,PD, LGD models)

  • Communication skills to explain complex methods to non‑technical audiences; clear documentation.

title: Assistant Manager - Data Science
jobDescription:
Designation: Assistant Manager – Data Science (Credit Risk Strategy)

Level: L3

Experience: 6–10 Years

Location: Colombo

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Assistant Manager – Data Science (Credit Risk Strategy) to join our team. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in credit card risk management, underwriting strategies, portfolio profitability analysis, and credit program design. This role will focus on developing data-driven credit strategies, optimizing portfolio performance, and supporting business growth through effective risk management practices.

Key Responsibilities

Credit Strategy & Program Design

• Design and implement credit programs and underwriting strategies for both Existing-to-Bank (ETB) and New-to-Bank (NTB) customer segments.

• Develop pre-approved and pre-qualified lending programs for offering credit cards to savings account and debit card customers.

• Define eligibility criteria, risk policies, and credit decision frameworks to support portfolio growth while maintaining risk controls.

• Design and optimize customer acquisition strategies across various customer segments, including salaried and self-employed individuals.

Portfolio Analytics & Risk Management

• Analyze loss provisioning data and portfolio performance metrics to identify profitable customer segments and growth opportunities.

• Assess portfolio profitability drivers and recommend strategies to improve overall portfolio performance.

• Evaluate customer risk profiles using bureau data, behavioral indicators, alternative data, and transactional information.

• Support the development and refinement of credit policies, underwriting rules, and credit line assignment strategies.

• Collaborate with business, risk, and product teams to implement data-driven credit decisioning frameworks.

Stakeholder Management & Business Collaboration

• Communicate credit policies, portfolio insights, and strategic recommendations to business stakeholders and senior management.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to enhance digital credit journeys and improve customer experience.

• Provide analytical support for portfolio monitoring, risk assessment, and business planning initiatives.

Required Skills & Qualifications

• 6–10 years of experience in Credit Risk, Risk Strategy, Portfolio Analytics, or Data Science roles within Banking or Financial Services.

• Strong working knowledge of Credit Cards, Credit Risk Management, and Lending Products.

• Good understanding of underwriting processes for various customer segments, including Existing-to-Bank (ETB), New-to-Bank (NTB), Salaried, and Self-Employed customers.

• Experience in designing credit programs, pre-approved offers, and pre-qualified lending strategies.

• Understanding of credit line assignment methodologies and portfolio risk management practices.

• Knowledge of loss provisioning concepts and key profitability drivers within a credit card portfolio.

• Familiarity with bureau data, credit bureau attributes, reason codes, alternative data sources, and identity/behavioral signals.

• Understanding of credit risk capabilities and decisioning within digital customer journeys.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to explain credit policies and risk concepts to non-technical audiences.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.

Preferred Skills

• Exposure to Application Scorecards, Behavioral Scorecards, PD, LGD, and Loss Forecasting Models.

• Experience in Credit Risk Modeling and Portfolio Optimization.

• Knowledge of IFRS 9, CECL, or Basel risk management frameworks.

• Experience with SQL, Python, SAS, Tableau, or other analytical tools.

• Understanding of customer lifecycle management and portfolio growth strategies.

• Experience working in digital lending and credit card acquisition ecosystems.

Primary Skills

• Credit Risk Strategy

• Credit Card Analytics

• Credit Program Design

• Underwriting & Risk Policy

• Portfolio Profitability Analysis

• Credit Line Management

• Bureau Data Analytics

• Loss Provisioning Analysis

• Portfolio Risk Management

• Problem Solving & Decision Science

• Stakeholder Management

• Banking & Financial Services Analytics
